title: 3D model viewer and editor. Free tool
author: shottycoin
selftext:
Hey guys,

We built a small tool for ourselves while making games — just to quickly preview, tweak and convert 3D models without opening heavy stuff like Blender every time.

Ended up using it way more than expected, so we decided to just make it public. 



You can:

\- view 3D models instantly (GLB, glTF, OBJ etc)

\- check animations

\- swap textures

\- convert formats in one click



No login. Free. will probably stay like this.

Not planning to turn this into some big product or whatever, but if people actually use it and ask for stuff — we can improve it. Just curious if this is useful for anyone else here

Link: [pixelfork.ai/3d-editor](http://pixelfork.ai/3d-editor)
